1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the requests are specifically for filing proofs of claim in bankruptcy proceedings;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and include proof of claim forms tailored to each bankruptcy organization's specific requirements; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations in compliance with each organization's filing procedures and deadlines.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step includes transforming a single creditor data record into multiple proof of claim documents, each formatted according to the specific filing requirements of the respective bankruptcy court.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim, and wherein the proof of claim includes claim amount, claim classification, and supporting documentation requirements specific to each bankruptcy organization;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and wherein the generating step includes validating claim amounts against creditor records and formatting each proof of claim according to the specific requirements of the target bankruptcy organization; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations on a scheduled basis.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the method further includes mapping creditor data fields to the specific proof of claim form fields required by each bankruptcy court.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors of the filing status of their proofs of claim and provide confirmation of successful filing with each bankruptcy organization.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol, and wherein the received data records are encrypted and authenticated prior to processing.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site, and wherein the Web site includes validation of creditor identity and authorization prior to accepting proof of claim data.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day, and wherein the batch filing is coordinated with the filing deadlines of each bankruptcy organization.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report specific to each creditor showing the status of their filed proofs of claim; and
sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site, and wherein the report includes filing confirmation details from each bankruptcy organization.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed, including reasons related to data validation failures or bankruptcy organization filing deadline expirations.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim from each bankruptcy organization and storing the receipt in association with the creditor's account.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer, and wherein the server computer maintains a queue of proofs of claims awaiting filing and automatically submits batches according to each bankruptcy organization's filing schedule.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record against creditor account information and bankruptcy organization filing requirements prior to generating the proof of claim.
